properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens. It must have at least 32 characters.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-days
properties.description: Number of days a JWT token stays valid.

properties.name: iam.default-password
properties.description: Password given to demo users and to team members created without a password.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma separated list of frontend origins allowed to call the API.
